labels.interpretation: Exact increment-bearing function reuse is a structural finding; may coexist with obfuscation.

similarity: Byte-length-weighted multiset Jaccard of exact function bodies including local declarations; excludes imports, globals, data, and metadata
tie_rule: Anchor seeds keep own identity; other best-score ties resolved by lexicographic SHA and disclosed
weighting: Mean within each modeled group, then equal mean across groups; unmatched files are singleton groups
limitations: Exact-body matching misses changed instrumented functions
Common library code can induce high similarity
Structural markers are not obfuscation prevalence
